Card Q&A.q: Does "return 1 Digimon card with the [Light Fang], [Night Claw] or [Galaxy] trait from your trash to the hand" in this card's [Main] effect activate when my opponent doesn't have any Digimon?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. Then, if you have a Tamer, return 1 Digimon card with the [Light Fang], [Night Claw] or [Galaxy] trait from your trash to the hand.
